title: Soccer Jersey Maker (2026)
verdict: The soccer jersey maker to open first in 2026 is Wooter's builder. Pick a soccer style, set your colors, add the crest and a sponsor, and the kit and its price update as you edit.
Custom Ink's Design Lab is the simple choice for printing on a stock jersey. Champro and Nike Team have makers that hand a design to a dealer. Boombah's builder covers sublimated uniforms.

steps.text: Solid, stripes, hoops or a sash.

steps.name: Set the colors
steps.text: A main color, a second and an accent for trim.

steps.name: Add the sponsor
steps.text: Centered on the front, if your league allows one.

steps.name: Number the back
steps.text: And the shorts, if your league asks for it.

steps.name: Add the roster and order
steps.text: Name, number and size per player.

ranking.lacks: A print tool. The jersey underneath is a stock style.

ranking.lacks: Ends in a design for a dealer to order.

ranking.fit: Teams that like building a sublimated uniform online. Each one is printed, cut and sewn to order.
ranking.lacks: Soccer is a smaller part of its range than baseball and softball.

ranking.fit: Clubs that want Nike and can plan around a dealer's timeline.

why: A soccer jersey has four fixed points: crest on the left chest, sponsor across the front, number on the back and sometimes a small number on the front. A maker should place all four without a fight.
Wooter's does, and it starts from finished styles, so stripes, hoops and sashes are a click, not a drawing job.
After the jersey, the same design goes onto shorts and socks, and the roster copies across.

faq.q: Is the soccer jersey maker free?
faq.a: Yes. Wooter's builder and design service are free. You pay when you order.

faq.q: Can I upload our club crest?
faq.a: Yes. A vector file is best and a clean PNG works.
Yes. The minimum is one on most Wooter product pages.

faq.q: Does it make a goalkeeper jersey?
faq.a: Yes. Make it in the same style with contrasting colors.

faq.q: How long until the kit arrives?
faq.a: About three to four weeks once the design is approved. Ask Wooter about rush production for a tighter date.
